# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v4 c1 P20](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P22](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0022), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v4 c1 P4](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is a neat, plain, and wholesome-looking girl who grows into a sensible young woman. She is described as having a fat hand and a plump figure that remains somewhat stout. On her wedding day, she wore a white satin dress adorned with seed pearls, tulle, lace, orange blossoms, and a large diamond cluster ring.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c36 P10](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0010), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020)_

## Personality

Jane is practical, sensible, and matter-of-fact, lacking in vivid imagination or romantic inclination. She is a neat, plodding, and conscientious worker who values order and discipline, believing in strictness and corporal punishment when teaching. Never given to saying anything unkind or gossiping, she maintains a polite, calm, and lady-like demeanor. Though plain-spoken and sometimes stiff when offended, she remains a loyal and reliable friend.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v2 c4 P4](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0004), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014), [v2 c4 P20](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0020), [v2 c18 P18](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0018), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020)_

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. After studying in Miss Stacy's extra class, she attended Queen's Academy, where she excelled in domestic science and obtained a teacher's license. She taught school at Newbridge for two years, earning a place on the School Inspector's Roll of Honor. Jane participated actively in the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, serving as chairman of the committee to paint and shingle the assembly hall. Following her teaching career in Newbridge, she accepted a school position in western Canada. While out West, she became engaged to Edward Inglis, a wealthy Winnipeg businessman originally from England. Jane returned to Avonlea and married Mr. Inglis at her parents' home in a lavish ceremony before embarking on a European wedding tour and settling in Winnipeg.
